startup.auth_mode.none: Sign-in is disabled (AUTH_MODE=none) – the application must be protected by a VPN or another layer.
startup.auth_mode.proxy_header: Taking the identity from reverse proxy headers: {headers}
startup.trivy.missing: Trivy not found (looked in TRIVY_BIN, {fallback} and PATH) – scanning is disabled. Install it with scripts/install-trivy.sh.
startup.git.missing: git not found in PATH – scanning is disabled. Add the git package to the environment.
startup.config.missing: Scanning configuration is missing: {variables}. The application runs, scanning is disabled.
startup.frontend.missing: The built frontend is missing in {path} – the API works, the web interface does not. Run the build: cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build.
config.database_url.missing: The required variable DATABASE_URL with the PostgreSQL connection is missing (e.g. postgresql://user:password@host:5432/database). Set it in the application environment and start it again.
config.invalid: The configuration in the environment variables is invalid: {detail}
error.frontend_not_built: The web interface is not built. Run the frontend build (cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build) or use the Docker image.
error.not_found: The requested endpoint does not exist.
startup.database.ready: The database is ready (migrated to head).
startup.source.unreachable: Repository source {url} does not respond: {detail}. Targets and scanning stay unavailable until the connection is back.
startup.source.not_configured: The repository source is not configured (GITLAB_TOKEN is missing) – managing scan targets is disabled.
error.internal: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again, or check the application log.
validation.kind_invalid: Unknown target type “{kind}”. Use a group or a project.
validation.source_ref_required: Choose a group or a project in the source.
validation.max_branches_out_of_range: The branch limit per project must be between {min} and {max}.
validation.branch_pattern_invalid: Branch pattern “{pattern}” is not valid. Use a branch name or a glob pattern, for example release/*.
validation.path_pattern_invalid: Exclusion pattern “{pattern}” is not valid. Use a glob over the project path, for example sandbox/*.
validation.branch_selection_empty: With a custom selection, enter at least one branch pattern or enable scanning the default branch.
validation.cron_invalid: Cron expression “{expression}” is not valid. Five fields are expected, for example 0 2 * * *.
validation.search_too_short: Enter at least {min} characters to search.
target.not_found: Scan target with ID {id} does not exist.
source.not_configured: The repository source is not configured. Set the variables GITLAB_URL and GITLAB_TOKEN.
source.unauthorized: The repository source rejected the token (401). Check GITLAB_TOKEN and whether it is still valid.
source.forbidden: The token lacks permissions (403). It needs the Reporter role and the read_api and read_repository scopes.
source.not_found: The repository source did not find such a group, project or branch (404).
source.rate_limited: The repository source refuses more requests because of a rate limit (429). Try again shortly.
source.http_error: The repository source responded with error {status}.
source.unreachable: Could not connect to the repository source. Check GITLAB_URL, the network and, if needed, CA_BUNDLE.
source.invalid_response: The repository source returned a response I do not understand.
discovery.skipped.no_default_branch: The project has no default branch.
discovery.branch.not_found: Branch “{branch}” does not exist in this project, skipped.
discovery.branch.pattern_no_match: No branch in this project matches pattern “{pattern}”.
discovery.branches.trimmed: There are more branches than the limit of {limit}; skipping {dropped} of them (keeping the default branch and the most recently committed ones).
startup.timezone.invalid: TZ contains an unknown time zone “{value}” – using UTC. Check the name, for example Europe/Prague.
startup.recovery: Cleaned up after restart: {jobs} interrupted jobs, {directories} temporary directories.
startup.dtrack.unsupported: Dependency-Track is version {version}; {minimum} or newer is supported – scanning is disabled.
startup.dtrack.unreachable: Dependency-Track {url} does not respond: {detail}. Scanning will try to connect again on the next run.
startup.dtrack.not_configured: Dependency-Track is not configured (DT_API_URL or DT_API_KEY is missing) – scanning is disabled.
scan.not_available: Scanning is not available. Check GITLAB_TOKEN, DT_API_URL, DT_API_KEY and whether Trivy is available.
run.not_found: Scan run with ID {id} does not exist.
scan.branch_invalid: Branch name “{branch}” is not safe to clone, skipping.
scan.trivy_missing: Trivy is not available – install it with scripts/install-trivy.sh, or set TRIVY_BIN.
scan.unexpected_error: The scan failed with an unexpected error. Details are in the application log.
clone.timeout: Cloning the repository did not finish within {seconds} s.
clone.branch_not_found: Branch “{branch}” does not exist in the repository.
clone.unauthorized: Clone refused – the token cannot read the repository (scope read_repository).
trivy.timeout: Trivy did not finish within {seconds} s.
sbom.missing: Trivy did not create the SBOM file.
sbom.invalid: The SBOM is not valid JSON.
sbom.not_cyclonedx: The SBOM is not in the CycloneDX format.
dtrack.unauthorized: Dependency-Track rejected the API key (401). Check DT_API_KEY.
dtrack.forbidden: The API key lacks permissions (403). It needs BOM_UPLOAD, PROJECT_CREATION_UPLOAD, VIEW_PORTFOLIO, VIEW_VULNERABILITY and PORTFOLIO_MANAGEMENT.
dtrack.not_found: Dependency-Track did not find the requested record (404).
dtrack.conflict: Dependency-Track rejected the change because of a conflict (409).
dtrack.unreachable: Could not connect to Dependency-Track. Check DT_API_URL, the network and, if needed, CA_BUNDLE.
dtrack.upload_no_token: Dependency-Track did not return a token for processing the SBOM.
dtrack.processing_timeout: Dependency-Track did not finish processing the SBOM within {seconds} s.
dtrack.project_not_found: After the upload, Dependency-Track did not find project {name} version {version}.
dtrack.bom_spec_version_unsupported: Dependency-Track cannot read an SBOM in CycloneDX version {version}. Use a Trivy version that generates a version your DT instance supports (see scripts/install-trivy.sh), or upgrade Dependency-Track.
dtrack.bom_invalid: Dependency-Track rejected the SBOM as invalid (400).
startup.scheduler.disabled: The scheduler is disabled because scanning is not available.
job.unchanged: Unchanged – the commit has not changed since the last scan.
run.not_cancellable: The run can no longer be cancelled, it is “{status}”.
project.not_found: Project with ID {id} does not exist.
project.branch_override_not_found: Project with ID {id} has no branch override.
dtrack.not_configured: Dependency-Track is not configured. Set the variables DT_API_URL and DT_API_KEY.
dtrack.version_unsupported: Dependency-Track has an unsupported version {version}. Features based on findings are therefore disabled.
project.not_scanned_yet: Project with ID {id} has not been scanned yet, so it has no findings.
startup.snapshots.backfilled: Backfilled {count} historical metric snapshots from Dependency-Track.
auth.header_missing: The identity header is missing ({headers}). In proxy-header mode the application must only be reachable through an authenticating reverse proxy – check that you are not accessing it directly.
validation.concurrency_out_of_range: Scan concurrency must be between {min} and {max}.
validation.retention_out_of_range: History retention must be between {min} and {max} days.
startup.auth_mode.proxy_header_warning: In proxy-header mode the application must not be reachable outside the reverse proxy – otherwise anyone can forge the identity header.
startup.ca_bundle.used: Using the custom CA from {path} for HTTP calls, git and Trivy.
startup.ca_bundle.missing: CA_BUNDLE points to {path}, but no such file exists – calls to GitLab and Dependency-Track may fail on the certificate.
validation.name_empty: The target name cannot be empty.
notify.headline: *Vulnyard: vulnerabilities in `{project}`* (branch `{branch}`)
notify.no_counts: Dependency-Track reports no finding counts for the project.
notify.maintainers_unknown: Could not find the repository members – check that the token can see project members.
notify.test: *Vulnyard: test message.* The webhook works, vulnerability notifications will be posted here.
settings.notifications.sent: Test message sent to the chat.
settings.notifications.sent_but_disabled: Test message sent to the chat. Notifications are turned off, though, so scans will not send anything until you enable them and save.
notify.not_configured: The notification webhook is not configured.
validation.webhook_invalid: The webhook must be an https URL.
notify.maintainers_inherited: The repository has no members of its own; group maintainers: {maintainers}
notify.unchanged: No change since the last scan.
notify.alert.headline: *Vulnyard: scanning is failing.*
notify.alert.summary: Run #{run}: {failed} of {total} jobs failed. Details are on the Scan runs page in the application.
startup.scheduler.locked: The scheduler is already running in another instance of the application, not starting it here (otherwise every cron would create two runs).
validation.source_url_invalid: The GitLab address must be an http or https URL.
validation.source_token_required: A target on another GitLab instance needs its own token too.
notify.resolved.headline: *Vulnyard: `{project}` is clean again* (branch `{branch}`)
notify.resolved.nothing_left: Dependency-Track reports no findings for the project.
validation.vuln_id_required: Enter a vulnerability identifier, for example CVE-2024-47764.
validation.vuln_id_too_long: A vulnerability identifier can have at most {limit} characters.
validation.purl_pattern_too_long: A component pattern can have at most {limit} characters.
validation.analysis_state_invalid: Unknown analysis state. Use one of: {allowed}.
ignore.not_found: Ignore rule with ID {id} does not exist.
ignore.duplicate: Such a rule already exists – same vulnerability, same pattern and same scope.
validation.expires_on_in_past: The date until which the rule holds cannot be in the past. To end the rule now, delete it.
auth.token_invalid: The API token is invalid, expired or deleted. Create a new one in Settings → API tokens.
auth.token_read_only: Token “{name}” may only read. Create a token with write access to make changes.
auth.token_management_forbidden: API tokens can only be managed by a person in the application, not by another token.
auth.token_required: The MCP endpoint needs an API token (Authorization: Bearer vy_…). Create one in Settings → API tokens; read access is enough.
mcp.repository_missing: Give a repository path such as group/project, or its git remote URL.
mcp.repository_unknown: Vulnyard does not scan “{repository}”. Use list_projects to find the exact path.
mcp.branch_unknown: Branch “{branch}” is not scanned. Scanned branches: {branches}.
mcp.project_not_scanned: “{repository}” has not been uploaded to Dependency-Track yet; check scan_status.
mcp.vulnerability_id_missing: Give a vulnerability id such as CVE-2026-1234 or GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx.
mcp.threshold_invalid: epss_threshold must be between 0 and 1 and new_days between 1 and 365.
api_token.not_found: API token with ID {id} does not exist.
validation.token_name_required: Enter a token name, so that it is clear who uses it.
validation.token_name_too_long: A token name can have at most {limit} characters.
validation.token_expires_on_in_past: The token expiry date cannot be in the past.
